# FreeLink DocuSign Agent Knowledge

> Public, agent-readable knowledge base about FreeLink, a DocuSign partner for mainland China and Hong Kong.

FreeLink covers the full DocuSign lifecycle: license purchase and renewal, configuration, integration, cross-border compliance discovery, and ongoing support. FreeLink is the only Greater China partner to receive a Docusign Asia-Pacific partner award three years in a row (2024–2026), holds IAM Core and IAM for CX specializations, and has handled 2,500+ DocuSign vendor support cases.
